test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

Amanda asked Mohit how she had offended his friend.

options.text: Amanda said to Mohit, “How did I offended his friend?”
Amanda said to Mohit, “How have I offended your friend?”
Amanda said to Mohit, “How she had offended his friend?”
Amanda said to Mohit, “How have I offend your friend?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct conversion from indirect to direct speech needs to **accurately reflect the question's tense and structure.**
 
• Option 2 correctly presents the direct form of the question maintaining the original tense and structure.
 
• In the direct format the** past perfect tense** of the verb is reversed to the** present perfect tense** and pronoun '**she'** is reversed to **' I'** as well.
 
• Format = **Reported verb, + "Reported Speech"**

Hence the correct statement is** ** '***Amanda said to Mohit,** **‘How have I offended your friend?’***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 is** incorrect **due to the mismatched tense – “did” should be “have”.
 
• Option 3 is** incorrect** as it mirrors the indirect speech rather than converting to direct speech.
 
• Option 4 is grammatically** incorrect **as “offend” should be “offended”.
